CanonAdditions: The keep has a central hub with an iron-bound door leading to the storage chamber.
Nella and Hobb are being held in the storage chamber of the keep.
Skrit Ironjaw occupies a room near the storage chamber.
A goblin lookout was stationed in the storage chamber, waiting for intruders.
The goblin lookout is younger than the chief and has a missing tooth.
The iron-bound door to the storage chamber is not locked but guarded by a pressure plate mechanism.
The pressure plate mechanism uses a loose stone block as a counterweight support.
Maren successfully removed the loose stone block, disabling the pressure plate trap.
Kaelen's brass gauntlet has a magical signature that can be disrupted physically and will not reactivate without rebuilding.
Torin marked the path to the storage chamber with chalk for the party's use.
The party successfully bypassed the goblin lookout in the storage chamber using stealth.
WorldStateUpdates: The party is currently inside the abandoned border keep beyond the woods.
The party has entered the central hub of the keep and disabled a trap at the entrance to the storage chamber.
The party has successfully navigated past the goblin lookout in the storage chamber.
The path from the storage chamber to the captives' location is clear.
Rain is falling outside the keep.
